66b1d403-af84-4f1c-bf87-57e0c41df0ba.quote: Murdock and Phase won the early duo-lane trades, taking first blood and five of six early deaths their way instead of ours. Belica never died despite an unfavored mid lane, and Zarus's only death came from getting caught alone by Aurora.
